requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Maintained-Q uniform-section lossless energy and continuity, circular radius, common speed-arrow scale and pressure head; exact 2/8 m/s and 30 kPa quiz state.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: No viscous head-loss solver, real pump operating point or physical diffuser design.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Pressure integration, absolute versus gauge datum, signed level difference, ideal vacuum and declared saturation constraints.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Static wide-tube case; flow losses, temperature-property fit, capillarity and tensile states are excluded.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: 50 N on 10 cm² gives 1000 N on 200 cm²; 0.2/0.01 m strokes transfer 10 J. Areas determine real circular radii.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Fixed same-elevation horizontal cylinders only; nonzero-elevation hydraulic work is not simulated.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Surface-pressure forces, conserved sealed external volume, load/retained-water mass, freeboard, neutral and overloaded capacity. Same-density retained fluid is rejected above the entire box volume; the bound does not establish sufficient real internal capacity.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Fixed upright sealed rectangular body; no stability, capsize, leak-rate or open flooded-hull simulation.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Radial collocation solution, annular flux, signed wall shear, viscous dissipation, Darcy relation and diameter-based Reynolds number.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Conditional laminar/developed Newtonian solution; no turbulent flow field or universal transition threshold.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Refined collocation Blasius solution, no-slip and far-field values, displacement/momentum integrals, wall shear and actual SVG dimensional profile.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Steady zero-pressure-gradient laminar attached thin boundary layer; no leading-edge, separation or transition solution.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Signed force ODE, rising/sinking/neutral spheres, initial/long-time balance, viscosity comparison and tiny-time displacement.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Declared memoryless particle inertia omits added mass and Basset history; low Re alone does not validate the transient.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Complex-potential velocity, closed-surface pressure force, outward normals, clockwise circulation sign and Kutta cusp, actual force arrows and Cp legend.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Ideal 2D incompressible inviscid attached flow; no real-wing performance, stall, compressibility or viscous/induced drag prediction.

requirements.accepted_bounded_evidence: Normalized far-field scaling and dimensional radius Reynolds number; width ×8, speed ×0.5 and Re ×4 at height ×8.
requirements.remaining_scope_limits: Scaling only: no resolved mass/entrainment/buoyancy flow budget, eddies or onset prediction.

scope_note: All 10 authored quiz items are mapped and their stated calculations/assumptions reviewed. Acceptance of these bounded idealized activities is not a claim that every original requirement, all external lesson content or all desired image/3D coverage is complete.
